description: Tower of Hanoi puzzle with disks on pegs
layout: 3 pegs arranged horizontally, disks stacked vertically

critical_relations.on: disk1 on disk2 means disk1 is on top of disk2 - draw vertically stacked
critical_relations.on-peg: disk1 on-peg peg1 means disk1 is at the bottom of peg1

positioning_rules: Pegs should be evenly spaced horizontally
Disks should be stacked vertically on pegs
Larger disks should be at the bottom
Use different colors or sizes to distinguish disks
